releaseNotes:
🚀 v1.9.3 Release: Streamlined Call Forwarding Controls
• 🔀 AI Call Forwarding Toggle: Replaced raw phone number display with clean ON/OFF toggle controls
• 📞 1-Tap Carrier Activation: One-tap 'Turn ON' and 'Turn OFF' carrier forwarding setup
• 🔒 Private Routing: Internal forwarding numbers are kept seamless and confidential under the hood
• 🟢 Real-time Status: Visual indicator showing whether unanswered call forwarding is active or paused
